title: Tarik Hasani
_note: PRO_03: the Collector at Dalia's stall. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

start.speaker: Tarik
start.text: [He tips Dalia's cart over with his boot, 'checking for contraband'.] Three sacks for the Patriot's Share, two for the processing, one for my trouble. Smile, woman. You're helping Hammerfell.

do.run: free tarik; free collector1; free collector2

watched.speaker: Tarik
watched.text: [He collects his six sacks, whistling, and does not look at you once.] Good day, Saltreach. Pay on time and we'll all stay friends.

backdown.speaker: Tarik
backdown.text: [He looks you over for a long moment. Then he smiles.] So she has. My mistake. Look at that, an honest man and a farmer. Two rare things. I'll remember you.

do.run: free tarik; free collector1; free collector2

mock.speaker: Tarik
mock.text: A farmer who counts! [Laughter from the guards.] Then count this. [He takes a fourth sack anyway.] I'll remember you.

do.run: free tarik; free collector1; free collector2

standoff.speaker: Tarik
standoff.text: [The guards close in. Behind the stall, Dalia whispers: 'Don't.' Tarik holds your eye, then laughs and puts his hand up.] Another day, farmer. You and I will have another day.

do.run: free tarik; free collector1; free collector2
